name: hcapp_syncUserData
description: Incremental pull-sync for the mobile app (ValidateAppAuth, spNumber 70; no permission gate — every rowset is either global reference data or scoped to the authenticated user). Each entity type is gated by a watermark parameter: 'ignore' (default), NULL or <= 2000-01-01 skips that table. Returns one result set per non-ignored watermark in this fixed order: Hashers, Cities, Regions, Countries, Songs, Products, Kennels, HasherKennelMap, HasherEventMap, NarrowEvents, Payments, then ForceReplicateKennelEvents. Also used by write SPs after mutations to push changed rows back in the same response (delegation mode: the write SP passes its own name and token suffix as @procName/@param). isMember in the HasherKennelMap rowset is computed from MembershipExpirationDate rather than the stored IsMember column. @includeUnboundPayments and @productsUpdatedAfter are defaulted so pre-3.1 clients that omit them see neither event-less payments nor products. Read SP: no success envelope; the body is wrapped in TRY/CATCH that logs to HC.ErrorLog and re-throws (the client treats a failure as 'fall back to offline').

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token. Validated via HC6.ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: hashersUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark (DATETIMEOFFSET string) for HC.Hasher. 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Hashers rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: citiesUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.City (only cities with at least one Kennel). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Cities rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: regionsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Region (only regions with at least one Kennel). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Regions rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: countriesUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Country (all countries). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Countries rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: kennelsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Kennel (all kennels). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Kennels rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.HasherKennelMap (user-scoped: only rows where UserId = authenticated user). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the HasherKennelMap rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.HasherEventMap (user-scoped: only rows where UserId = authenticated user). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the HasherEventMap rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: narrowEventsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Event (narrow sync: events within 10 days, at followed kennels, or attended by user). Skipped when @forceReplicateAllRunsForKennel is active. 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: paymentsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Payment (user-scoped: only rows where UserId = authenticated user). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Payments rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: songsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Song (all songs globally). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Songs rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: productsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Product (the kennel catalogue, 3.1; global — every kennel's products). 'ignore' (default), NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Products rowset, so a client that does not know about products never receives it.

parameters.name: forceReplicateAllRunsForKennel
parameters.description: Kennel id as a string. When not NULL and not 'ignore', the NarrowEvents rowset is suppressed and ForceReplicateKennelEvents is returned instead — every event of that kennel that is recent (EventStartLocal within 10 days back or later), at a kennel the caller follows, or one the caller has a HasherEventMap row for with AttendenceState >= 3. No updatedAt watermark applies. A string that is not a GUID makes the CAST at line 148 throw (logged, then re-raised).

parameters.name: usePaging
parameters.description: When 0 (default) or NULL: unlimited rows (write-SP delegation). When 1: 2500 rows for Hashers, 250 for every other rowset.

parameters.name: initialLoad
parameters.description: Accepted but never used in the SP body. Kept for caller compatibility. Reserved for future initial-load optimisation.

parameters.name: includeUnboundPayments
parameters.description: Default 0. 0 = omit payments with a NULL EventId or HasherEventMapId (run packages, hare rewards), which pre-3.1 clients cannot parse (payments_model_ns.dart declares eventId/hemId required); 1 = return every payment. 3.1+ sends 1. Chosen over a forked SP (James, 2026-09-13).

parameters.name: procName
parameters.description: Delegation parameter. The calling write SP passes its own name here so the token is validated in the context of that SP. NULL means direct call (uses this SP's own name for auth).

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: Delegation parameter. The calling write SP passes its token suffix here for auth. NULL means validate against DeviceSecret only.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when authentication fails. errorType=11 (auth). This rowset is emitted instead of any data rowsets — execution returns immediately.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: Effective SP name (delegating or own) via COALESCE(@procName, OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)).

rowsets.name: Hashers
rowsets.description: All HC.Hasher rows updated after @hashersUpdatedAfter watermark. Not user-scoped — returns all hashers. Page size: 2500 (when paging enabled). Emitted only when @hashersUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'.

columns.name: unpinnedMismanagementRooms
columns.description: Chat-room pin preferences (E9.F1.S8), bit per mismanagement room the caller unpinned. Masked to the CALLER: 0 for every other hasher in this global rowset. Type from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-15_chat_pinning.sql.

columns.name: unpinnedAppAccessRooms
columns.description: As unpinnedMismanagementRooms, for app-access rooms. Masked to the caller. Type from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-15_chat_pinning.sql.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Hasher.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped). Note: COALESCE(updatedAt, GETDATE()) used — rows without updatedAt receive current server time.

rowsets.name: Cities
rowsets.description: HC.City rows updated after @citiesUpdatedAfter watermark. Filtered to cities that have at least one Kennel (EXISTS subquery). Includes ianaTimeZone from DomainValues.Timezone LEFT JOIN. Page size: 250. Emitted only when @citiesUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'.

columns.name: ianaTimeZone
columns.description: DomainValues.Timezone.IanaTimeZone. Defaults to 'Europe/London' via COALESCE if NULL or no matching timezone row.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: City.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

rowsets.name: Regions
rowsets.description: HC.Region rows updated after @regionsUpdatedAfter watermark. Filtered to regions that have at least one Kennel (EXISTS subquery on ProvinceStateId). Page size: 250. Emitted only when @regionsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Region.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

rowsets.name: Countries
rowsets.description: HC.Country rows updated after @countriesUpdatedAfter watermark. All countries, no scoping filter. Page size: 250. Emitted only when @countriesUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Country.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

rowsets.name: Songs
rowsets.description: HC.Song rows updated after @songsUpdatedAfter watermark. All songs globally (no user scope). Page size: 250. Emitted only when @songsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. Note: Songs are emitted before Kennels in the parameter/emit order.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Song.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

rowsets.name: Products
rowsets.description: Emitted only when @productsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. HC.Product rows (the kennel catalogue, 3.1) updated after the watermark — GLOBAL, every kennel's products, so a hasher's past payment always resolves its product. SourceJson (supplier name/phone, kennel-admin data) is deliberately NOT returned. A sold product is never removed, only IsActive = 0. Ordered by updatedAt, id. Page size: 250. Column types from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-13_create_Product.sql and 2026-09-13_product_json_rework.sql (no table file in db/schema/tables).

columns.name: pricingJson
columns.description: All pricing in one JSON field (single price, member/non-member, choice of amounts, per size, deposit + balance).

columns.name: productDetailsJson
columns.description: Product details JSON safe for every phone.

columns.name: isActive
columns.description: 1 = on sale; 0 = taken off sale (kept so old payments resolve).

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), CAST(updatedAt AS DATETIME2)). Next watermark.

rowsets.name: Kennels
rowsets.description: HC.Kennel rows updated after @kennelsUpdatedAfter watermark. All kennels (no user scope). INNER JOINs HC.City to derive fallback lat/lon. OPTION (RECOMPILE) hint. DefaultRunStartTime converted via CONVERT(DATETIME,'1900-01-01') + CONVERT(DATETIME, time). Page size: 250. Emitted only when @kennelsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'.

columns.name: defaultMessagingPlatform
columns.description: Which messaging app 'Post this run' opens (E9.F6). COALESCE to 1 = WhatsApp. Type from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-15_kennel_messaging.sql.

columns.name: messagingGroupInviteUrl
columns.description: Invite link to the kennel's messaging group. Type from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-15_kennel_messaging.sql.

columns.name: cardPaymentProvider
columns.description: Card app the Hash Cash hands off to (e.g. 'sumup'), E8.F7.S1. Type from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-22_kennel_payment_provider.sql.

columns.name: cardPaymentMerchantCode
columns.description: Merchant code shown before handing off to the card app (E8.F7.S2). Type from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-22_kennel_payment_provider.sql.

columns.name: allowCredit
columns.description: Kennel.AllowCredit — master flag: whether credit payments are allowed for this kennel (1=on, default 1). Type from db/hc6/app/archive/migration_add_AllowCredit_to_Kennel.sql.

columns.name: permissionOverrideJson
columns.description: The kennel's compiled permission overrides (permissions v2). Type from db/hc6/app/archive/migration_permissions_v2_03_projection_columns.sql.

columns.name: membershipRenewalMode
columns.description: Membership renewal rule: 1=rolling, 2=fixed year, 3=lifetime. Added 2026-08-08 (membership payments).

columns.name: membershipPeriodStartDate
columns.description: Fixed-year mode: start of the kennel membership year.

columns.name: membershipPeriodEndDate
columns.description: Fixed-year mode: end of the kennel membership year; payments extend to the day after this.

columns.name: membershipPrice
columns.description: Default membership fee, pre-filled in the charge dialog (overridable per charge).

columns.name: kennelLatitude
columns.description: COALESCE(Kennel.Latitude, City.Latitude). Falls back to city lat if kennel has no override.

columns.name: kennelLongitude
columns.description: COALESCE(Kennel.Longitude, City.Longitude). Falls back to city lon if kennel has no override.

columns.name: defaultRunStartTime
columns.description: Kennel.DefaultRunStartTime combined with sentinel date 1900-01-01 via DATETIME arithmetic.

columns.name: trailSymbolsConfigJson
columns.description: Per-kennel trail symbol configuration JSON, or NULL.

columns.name: trailTypesConfigJson
columns.description: Per-kennel trail-type config JSON, or NULL. Type from db/hc6/archive/add_TrailTypesConfigJson_to_Kennel.sql.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Kennel.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

rowsets.name: HasherKennelMap
rowsets.description: HC.HasherKennelMap rows for the authenticated user updated after @hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter watermark (WHERE UserId = @userId). isMember is computed dynamically from MembershipExpirationDate > GETDATE() — not from the stored IsMember column. authorizedDeviceList and authorizedDeviceCount are returned as empty string / 0 respectively (stripped in HC6). Page size: 250. Emitted only when @hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'.

columns.name: isMember
columns.description: Computed: 1 if COALESCE(MembershipExpirationDate,'2000-01-01') > GETDATE(), else 0. Does NOT read the stored IsMember column.

columns.name: authorizedDeviceList
columns.description: Always empty string '' in HC6. Device list was removed from this SP.

columns.name: authorizedDeviceCount
columns.description: Always 0 in HC6. Device count was removed from this SP.

columns.name: pinned
columns.description: Chat pin for this kennel (E9.F1.S8). NULL = use the default (home kennel pinned), applied by the phone. Type from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-15_chat_pinning.sql.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

rowsets.name: HasherEventMap
rowsets.description: HC.HasherEventMap rows for the authenticated user updated after @hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter watermark (WHERE UserId = @userId). INNER JOINs HC.Event for denormalised event fields. LEFT JOINs HC.HasherKennelMap for kennel-specific user photo and hash name. Page size: 250. Emitted only when @hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. notes is the caller's OWN note, returned unmasked (user-scoped rowset); notesShared applies the kennel (KennelStanding & 0x1000) and platform (Preferences & 0x2000) overrides.

columns.name: notes
columns.description: The hasher's own private notes on the run (E3.F4.S5, 2026-09-11). User sync only — not in the kennel or event admin rowsets.

columns.name: notesShared
columns.description: 1 when shared and neither admin override is set.

columns.name: hemEventName
columns.description: FB/non-FB event name from joined Event row.

columns.name: hemEventStartDatetime
columns.description: CONVERT(DATETIME2, Event.EventStartDatetime) — local wall-clock value with the offset dropped.

columns.name: trackGzip
columns.description: The hasher’s own archived PackTrack trail (TrackArchiveCodec v1, gzipped; base64 on the wire). Null until the nightly archive has run. This rowset only — the admin domains never carry it (E5.F7.S1, 2026-09-12).

columns.name: trackPointCount
columns.description: Points in the hasher’s trail on this run; > 0 with a null trackGzip means tracked, archive not yet delivered.

columns.name: trackFirstPointAt
columns.description: CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), HasherEventMap.TrackFirstPointAt) — DATETIME2(3) as text. NULL when the hasher has no track.

columns.name: trackLastPointAt
columns.description: Capture time (UTC) of the last point.

columns.name: hemKennelUserPhoto
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.KennelUserPhoto for user+kennel combo. NULL if no HKM row.

columns.name: hemKennelHashName
columns.description: HasherKennelMap.KennelHashName for user+kennel combo. NULL if no HKM row.

columns.name: pinned
columns.description: Chat pin for this run (E9.F1.S8): COALESCE(Pinned, 0). A run never auto-pins. Type from db/hc6/app/archive/2026-09-15_chat_pinning.sql.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: HasherEventMap.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

rowsets.name: NarrowEvents
rowsets.description: HC.Event rows updated after @narrowEventsUpdatedAfter watermark, filtered to: (a) events within 10 days of start, OR (b) events at a kennel the user follows (HasherKennelMap.Following = 1), OR (c) events the user attended (HasherEventMap.AttendenceState >= 3). Skipped when @forceReplicateAllRunsForKennel is active. OPTION (RECOMPILE). Page size: 50. Note: eventDescription maps to Event.SyncDescription (not Event.EventDescription).

columns.name: trackRunnerCount
columns.description: Attendance rows on this run with a PackTrack track. Kept by HC.trgHasherEventMapActivityCount via HC6.nonApi_refreshEventActivity; synced so the run card never asks the server (E5.F7.S1, 2026-09-12).

columns.name: photoCount
columns.description: Approved, undeleted run photos (Status >= 2). Kept by HC.trgKennelPhotosActivityCount.

columns.name: messageCount
columns.description: Trail-chat messages not removed. Kept by HC.trgEventMessageActivityCount.

columns.name: downDownCount
columns.description: Down-down charges not cancelled. Kept by HC.trgDownDownsActivityCount.

columns.name: eventImage
columns.description: FB/non-FB image URL based on UseFbImage flag.

columns.name: eventCoverPhotoUrl
columns.description: The run's cover photo URL — a copy of the chosen HC.KennelPhotos BlobUrl/EditedBlobUrl, kept by photo-status SPs. No DDL for this column was found in the repo; type assumed from HC.KennelPhotos.BlobUrl NVARCHAR(500).

columns.name: eventName
columns.description: FB/non-FB event name based on UseFbRunDetails flag.

columns.name: eventStartDatetime
columns.description: CONVERT(DATETIME2, Event.EventStartDatetime) — local wall-clock value; the stored offset (spurious +00:00 on most rows) is dropped. See /hc-event-datetimes.

columns.name: eventDescription
columns.description: Event.SyncDescription (NOT Event.EventDescription — this differs from the force-replicate path which uses FB/non-FB EventDescription).

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Event.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

rowsets.name: Payments
rowsets.description: HC.Payment rows for the authenticated user (WHERE UserId = @userId) updated after the watermark. When @includeUnboundPayments = 0 (default) rows with a NULL EventId or HasherEventMapId are excluded. PaidDate, CancelledDate and ConfirmedDate are CAST to DATETIME (offset and sub-millisecond precision lost). Ordered by updatedAt, id. Page size: 250. Emitted only when @paymentsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'.

columns.name: hemId
columns.description: Payment.HasherEventMapId. NULL only for event-less payments (run packages, hare rewards), returned only when @includeUnboundPayments = 1. db/schema/tables/HC.Payment.Table.sql still says NOT NULL; it is stale.

columns.name: eventId
columns.description: Payment.EventId. NULL only for event-less payments (run packages, hare rewards), returned only when @includeUnboundPayments = 1. db/schema/tables/HC.Payment.Table.sql still says NOT NULL; it is stale.

columns.name: paidDate
columns.description: Payment.PaidDate cast to DATETIME (DATETIMEOFFSET precision and timezone lost).

columns.name: cancelledDate
columns.description: Payment.CancelledDate cast to DATETIME (DATETIMEOFFSET precision and timezone lost).

columns.name: confirmedDate
columns.description: Payment.ConfirmedDate cast to DATETIME (DATETIMEOFFSET precision and timezone lost).

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Payment.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

rowsets.name: ForceReplicateKennelEvents
rowsets.description: Emitted only when @forceReplicateAllRunsForKennel is not NULL and not 'ignore' (and then NarrowEvents is suppressed). Events of that kennel that are recent (EventStartLocal > now - 10 days), or at a kennel the caller follows, or that the caller has an HEM row for with AttendenceState >= 3 — so for a followed kennel this is every run. No updatedAt watermark is applied. Same columns as NarrowEvents with two differences: eventStartDatetimeGmt is CONVERT(DATETIME2, EventStartDatetimeGmt) (offset dropped, no fallback) rather than COALESCE(...) as DATETIMEOFFSET, and eventDescription is the inline FB/non-FB CASE rather than the persisted SyncDescription (same value). Ordered by updatedAt, id; page size 250 when @usePaging = 1.

columns.name: trackRunnerCount
columns.description: Attendance rows on this run with a PackTrack track. Kept by HC.trgHasherEventMapActivityCount via HC6.nonApi_refreshEventActivity; synced so the run card never asks the server (E5.F7.S1, 2026-09-12).

columns.name: photoCount
columns.description: Approved, undeleted run photos (Status >= 2). Kept by HC.trgKennelPhotosActivityCount.

columns.name: messageCount
columns.description: Trail-chat messages not removed. Kept by HC.trgEventMessageActivityCount.

columns.name: downDownCount
columns.description: Down-down charges not cancelled. Kept by HC.trgDownDownsActivityCount.

columns.name: eventImage
columns.description: FB/non-FB image URL based on UseFbImage flag.

columns.name: eventCoverPhotoUrl
columns.description: The run's cover photo URL — a copy of the chosen HC.KennelPhotos BlobUrl/EditedBlobUrl, kept by photo-status SPs. No DDL for this column was found in the repo; type assumed from HC.KennelPhotos.BlobUrl NVARCHAR(500).

columns.name: eventName
columns.description: FB/non-FB event name based on UseFbRunDetails flag.

columns.name: eventStartDatetime
columns.description: CONVERT(DATETIME2, Event.EventStartDatetime) — local wall-clock value; the stored offset (spurious +00:00 on most rows) is dropped. See /hc-event-datetimes.

columns.name: eventStartDatetimeGmt
columns.description: CONVERT(DATETIME2, Event.EventStartDatetimeGmt) — UTC instant with the offset dropped.

columns.name: eventDescription
columns.description: FB/non-FB EventDescription (NOT SyncDescription — this differs from NarrowEvents which uses SyncDescription).

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Event.updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string (timezone stripped).

sideEffects: Read-only. Inserts an HC.ErrorLog row on any unhandled error (CATCH at lines 738-746 logs, then re-throws).

codeSmells.issue: updatedAt serialised as local DATETIME2 string — timezone stripped
codeSmells.detail: All updatedAt columns are serialised via CONVERT(NVARCHAR(50), CAST(updatedAt AS DATETIME2)), which strips the timezone offset. Sync cursors sent by clients in different timezones can silently drift or replay rows. Should use DATETIMEOFFSET formatted string instead.

codeSmells.issue: eventDescription inconsistency between NarrowEvents and ForceReplicateKennelEvents
codeSmells.detail: NarrowEvents (line 575) returns the persisted computed column evt.SyncDescription; ForceReplicateKennelEvents (line 705) repeats the same CASE inline. HC.Event.SyncDescription is defined as exactly that CASE, so the values agree today, but the two paths can drift if either is edited alone.

codeSmells.issue: eventStartDatetimeGmt inconsistency between NarrowEvents and ForceReplicateKennelEvents
codeSmells.detail: NarrowEvents (line 574) returns COALESCE(EventStartDatetimeGmt, EventStartDatetime) as DATETIMEOFFSET; ForceReplicateKennelEvents (line 704) returns CONVERT(DATETIME2, EventStartDatetimeGmt) — a different type with the offset dropped and no fallback. The same run reaches the phone in two shapes depending on which path synced it.

codeSmells.issue: Watermark strings cast directly without TRY_CAST — invalid values throw unhandled exceptions
codeSmells.detail: SET @ua = CAST(@xUpdatedAfter AS DATETIMEOFFSET(7)) (lines 157, 189, 215, 237, 266, 305, 338, 427, 474, 538, 612) and CAST(@forceReplicateAllRunsForKennel AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) (line 148) throw on a malformed string. Since the 2026-07 TRY/CATCH retrofit the error is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown, so the client sees a raw 500 and falls back to offline rather than an error rowset.

codeSmells.issue: DefaultRunStartTime uses DATETIME + DATETIME arithmetic hack
codeSmells.detail: CONVERT(DATETIME,'1900-01-01') + CONVERT(DATETIME, k.DefaultRunStartTime) combines a sentinel date with a TIME-like column using DATETIME arithmetic. This is fragile on edge-case time values and will produce incorrect results if the column contains non-TIME-shaped data.

codeSmells.issue: Hasher.updatedAt uses COALESCE(updatedAt, GETDATE()) — rows with NULL updatedAt receive current server time
codeSmells.detail: The Hashers rowset uses COALESCE(h.updatedAt, GETDATE()) when serialising updatedAt. If a row has a NULL updatedAt it will be returned with the current server timestamp, which can cause phantom re-syncs across polling cycles.

codeSmells.issue: Payment dates downcast from DATETIMEOFFSET to DATETIME — timezone and sub-second precision lost
codeSmells.detail: paidDate, cancelledDate, and confirmedDate are all CAST to DATETIME. The Payment table stores these as DATETIMEOFFSET(7). Downcasting loses the timezone offset and truncates precision. Client timestamps for payment events may be inaccurate.
Declared and passed by callers for future initial-load optimisation, but has no effect on query logic. Kept for caller compatibility.

codeSmells.issue: authorizedDeviceList and authorizedDeviceCount returned as fixed stubs
codeSmells.detail: HasherKennelMap rowset always returns '' and 0 for these columns. If the Flutter app still reads them, it will silently receive empty data. These columns should be removed from the contract once the app no longer references them.

codeSmells.issue: Force-replicate path cannot page past its first 250 rows
codeSmells.detail: ForceReplicateKennelEvents (lines 667-735) applies no updatedAt watermark but does FETCH NEXT @paging250 with ORDER BY updatedAt. With @usePaging = 1 a followed kennel with more than 250 runs returns the same oldest-updated 250 on every call; the rest can only arrive through NarrowEvents.
Line 499 runs SELECT h.Preferences FROM HC.Hasher per HasherEventMap row to compute notesShared. Every row is the caller's, so one lookup into a variable before the SELECT would do.

Lines 600 and 730 use AttendenceState >= 3 to mean 'has any row for this run' (widens what syncs so a declined run still reaches history), not 'attended' (>= 20). Deliberate per CLAUDE.md, but uncommented here.

breakingChanges: isMember in HasherKennelMap rowset is now computed dynamically from MembershipExpirationDate > GETDATE() — HC5 read the stored IsMember column. Members whose stored IsMember flag was stale will now see accurate membership state, which may change behaviour for kennels where the column was not kept in sync.
@procName parameter widened from NVARCHAR(100) in HC5 to NVARCHAR(128) in HC6 to match OBJECT_NAME() return type.
@productsUpdatedAfter NVARCHAR(50) = 'ignore' added after @songsUpdatedAfter (3.1); the Products rowset is emitted between Songs and Kennels when requested.
@includeUnboundPayments SMALLINT = 0 added after @initialLoad (2026-09-13). Callers passing parameters by position must account for both additions.

Kennels rowset gained defaultMessagingPlatform, messagingGroupInviteUrl, cardPaymentProvider, cardPaymentMerchantCode, permissionOverrideJson, trailSymbolsConfigJson, trailTypesConfigJson; Hashers gained unpinnedMismanagementRooms/unpinnedAppAccessRooms; HasherKennelMap and HasherEventMap gained pinned; both event rowsets gained eventCoverPhotoUrl. All additive.
